fee_notes: Royalty is 6.0% of Gross Revenues due on the 10th of each month. Advertising Contribution is 0.5% of Gross Revenues for the National Materials Fund; franchisor reserves the right to increase this to 1.0%. Local Advertising Commitment is an additional 4.0% of Gross Revenues (pre-approved local spend, not paid to franchisor). POS Maintenance Fee ranges $193–$369/month paid directly to vendor. Biennial convention registration fee is $1,200/person. Transfer Fee is $10,000 ($2,000 per Center for unopened Centers under Multi-Unit Agreement). Transferee Training Fee is $2,500. Renewal Fee is $0–$5,000. Interest on late payments is lesser of 1.5%/month or highest rate allowed by law.
